name: Pull Shade
summary: A notification shade you pull down from the top, with tumbling tiles, a fanning stack and flick-away cards
about: A phone home screen with a notification shade that follows your finger down from the top edge. The wallpaper blurs behind it, the quick tiles and cards tumble in one after another, a stack of messages fans out when tapped and every card can be flicked away while the rest close the gap. The tiles really work: Wi-Fi and data change the status bar, the torch lights the screen, Do not disturb silences new banners and the slider dims the screen.
how: Drag down from the top edge (or tap the pill at the top) to pull the shade; let go past a third of the way and it springs open.
Tap the Messages stack to fan it out, then Show less to stack it again.
Swipe any card left or right to dismiss it, or press Clear all to sweep every card away; Bring them back restores them.
Try the tiles and the brightness slider, then drag the handle at the bottom up to close. A new message drops in as a banner unless Do not disturb is on.
Keyboard: Tab to a card and press Delete to dismiss it, Enter on the stack fans it out, Escape closes the shade.
